content.text:
Current runtime context. This snapshot supersedes earlier runtime-context snapshots.

Current DSH file policy: workspace-write. Any available operation enforced by the DSH file sandbox may modify files under the session workspace: "{{cwd}}". Some platform temporary areas may also be writable.
Process sandbox runner: bwrap; enforcement: full. Process temporary files are private to each command and do not survive into the next command. Use the workspace for files exchanged between commands or filesystem tools. Process temporary files are not the Host temporary files seen by ordinary filesystem tools. UID and GID visibility depends on the runner user namespace. Host root ownership and supplementary groups may be unmapped; do not assume Host identity checks or chown behave identically.

Approval policy: ask. Operations that require approval may ask through the configured answerers; without an available answerer, the request fails closed.
